extracted.intended_audience: owners/operators of electric utilities and independent power producers, state regulators, environmental consultants, and other stakeholders subject to CCR regulations
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register final rule establishing regulatory requirements for legacy CCR (coal combustion residuals) surface impoundments and CCR management units, including definitions, monitoring, closure, corrective action, and compliance deadlines under 40 CFR part 257. Intended to guide regulated entities and implementing authorities on obligations and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a “Legacy CCR Surface Impoundment”
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish what constitutes a legacy CCR surface impoundment, including date for determining applicability and whether an inactive impoundment 'contains both liquid and CCR'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes sub-elements: (a) Legacy CCR Surface Impoundment—Date for Determining Applicability; (b) Legacy CCR Surface Impoundment—Definition of an Inactive Impoundment—Contains Both Liquid and CCR; detailed discussion of what is a 'liquid', what it means to 'contain' CCR, whether the proposal reflected a 'new' interpretation, and consideration of adding a regulation definition. Also addresses definition of solid waste, exclusions, the requirement to be located at an 'inactive facility', and treatment of 'innocent owners'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable requirements and compliance deadlines for legacy CCR surface impoundments
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify which existing CCR regulatory requirements apply to legacy CCR surface impoundments and set compliance deadlines (including distinctions for units closed by removal versus closed with waste in place).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: general overview; applicable requirements for legacy CCR surface impoundments closed by removal and those closed with waste in place; compliance deadlines; new requirements specific to legacy impoundments such as applicability reports, site security, certification of closure by removal. EPA may defer certain deadlines in particular circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability report for legacy CCR surface impoundments
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to prepare and submit an applicability report documenting whether and how the legacy impoundment is subject to the rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a new requirement specific to legacy CCR surface impoundments; forms one of the compliance actions with associated deadlines and certification requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site security for legacy CCR surface impoundments
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to implement site security measures for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identified as a new requirement specific to legacy impoundments; intended to prevent unauthorized access and reduce risks associated with legacy units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification of closure by removal for legacy CCR surface impoundments
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to certify that closure by removal has been completed for units that choose that closure option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certification is a formal requirement tied to applicability and closure deadlines; related to documentation, potentially deed notation, and closure approval processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location restrictions and liner design criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria governing acceptable locations for legacy CCR surface impoundments and technical liner design standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears under new requirements; includes technical specifications intended to limit releases to groundwater and surface water and to meet performance standards in §257.102 and related provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design criteria for structural integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Design standards ensuring structural integrity of legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes requirements such as installation of a permanent marker, documentation/history of construction, initial hazard potential classification, initial structural stability assessment, initial safety factor assessment, and preparation of an Emergency Action Plan (EAP). These are meant to assess and mitigate failure risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation of a permanent marker and documentation of construction history
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to install a permanent marker for legacy CCR surface impoundments and maintain construction history records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marker and construction history facilitate identification, tracking, and the evaluation of past practices; linked to documentation and public posting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial hazard potential classification and structural/stability assessments
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation to perform an initial hazard potential classification and initial structural stability and safety factor assessments for legacy impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These assessments inform design, closure, and emergency planning decisions; they are initial (baseline) evaluations with expected follow-up actions as necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency Action Plan (EAP) preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to prepare an Emergency Action Plan for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EAP must cover foreseeable failure scenarios and response actions; linked to structural integrity and hazard classification requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating criteria including fugitive dust control and inspections
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational requirements for legacy CCR impoundments such as fugitive dust control plans, initial fugitive dust control report, weekly inspections, monthly instrumentation monitoring, and initial annual inspections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies both planning (control plans, initial reports) and routine operational checks (weekly inspections, monthly monitoring of unit instrumentation, annual inspections) to control exposures and detect issues early.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial inflow design flood control system plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to prepare an initial Inflow Design Flood (IDF) control system plan for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan must address flood-related risks to impoundment integrity and is part of the unit's design/operational risk controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Groundwater monitoring and corrective action criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive groundwater monitoring and corrective action requirements for legacy CCR surface impoundments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: design and installation of groundwater monitoring systems; development of groundwater sampling and analysis programs; combining detection and assessment monitoring programs; deadline for collection and analyses of eight independent samples; annual GWMCA reports; and corrective action requirements to attain groundwater protection standards (see §257.95(h) and §257.98(c)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Collection and analysis of eight independent samples requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Numeric requirement to collect and analyze eight independent groundwater samples as part of detection/assessment monitoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears for both legacy CCR surface impoundments and CCR management units; used as a trigger for assessment and to support determinations such as statistically significant increase (SSI) or statistically significant level (SSL). Deadlines apply for when these samples must be collected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual groundwater monitoring and corrective action reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to prepare and submit annual GWMCA reports documenting monitoring results and corrective actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports support transparency and regulatory oversight; linked to sampling programs, corrective action implementation, and public posting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrective action requirements to meet groundwater protection standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation to implement corrective measures to attain the groundwater protection standard where monitoring indicates contamination or exceedances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corrective action is defined to include actions specified in §257.98(c) and mechanisms to attain the standard in §257.95(h); may be implemented through remedy selection, implementation, and post-closure care.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closure and post-closure care criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing closure initiation, execution, and post-closure care for legacy CCR surface impoundments and CCR management units.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes requirement to close legacy impoundments, possible deferrals for critical infrastructure, requirement to comply with performance standards in §257.102 (including closure in place standards), provisions for closure under state law or deferral of certain completed closures, closure compliance deadlines (initiation, written closure plan, written post-closure care plan, deadline to complete closure), and post-closure care obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deferral provisions for critical infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Allowances to defer certain closure or compliance deadlines where units are designated as critical infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA may defer some compliance dates for units that meet critical infrastructure criteria; deferral does not eliminate substantive standards and EPA intends substantive standards to remain in place even if deferrals are challenged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to prepare written closure and post-closure care plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation to prepare written closure plans and written post-closure care plans for legacy CCR surface impoundments and CCRMU.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans must address how closure and post-closure activities will be completed and maintained; required by deadlines and subject to certification and potential public posting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recordkeeping, notification, and internet posting criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for maintaining records, providing notifications, and posting specified information on a publicly accessible internet site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers which documents must be retained and posted (e.g., closure certifications, monitoring reports, applicability reports). Cross-references ELG and other posting requirements and addresses publicly accessible site requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and regulation of CCR Management Units (CCRMU)
rubrics_metrics.description: Define CCRMUs (units where CCR are managed on the land) and establish applicable regulatory scope, including types of units and activities regulated and relationship to state law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discussion includes: RCRA authority; justification that subcategorization is appropriate because CCRMUs are dissimilar; size threshold for a CCRMU; exemptions for beneficial use of CCR and for roadbeds/associated embankments; and extent of requirements applied to CCRMU at active and inactive facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facility evaluation for identifying CCR management units (FER Part 1 & Part 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to conduct a facility evaluation in two parts to identify CCRMUs: Part 1 (information collection, data gap identification) and Part 2 (physical evaluation and remedy of data gaps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both parts must be certified; includes schedules and deadlines for submission and remediation of data gaps. FER supports identification of CCRMU scope and needed corrective measures or closure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable existing CCR requirements applied to CCRMUs
rubrics_metrics.description: Extension of a subset of existing 40 CFR part 257, subpart D requirements to CCRMUs, including deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes fugitive dust requirements, groundwater monitoring and corrective action (design/install, sampling plan, detection/assessment combined, eight-sample requirement, initial GWMCA report, corrective action), closure and post-closure care criteria (initiate closure, deferrals, performance standards, closure in place revisions, methods for identification/elimination of free liquids), preparation of written closure/post-closure plans, and recordkeeping/notification/internet posting for CCRMUs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closure of CCR units by removal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for closure of CCR units by removal, including removal and decontamination activities and related documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes implementation of the selected remedy, groundwater corrective action, closure and post-closure care plans, notation on the deed to the property, and closure certification or approval. EPA finalized provisions to allow staged closure by removal (removal/decontamination first, groundwater remediation in separate post-closure period).

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative closure provisions (staged closure by removal)
rubrics_metrics.description: Allow closure by removal to be completed in two stages: (1) complete removal and decontamination activities; (2) complete groundwater remediation during a separate post-closure care period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides regulatory flexibility so facilities can certify removal first and then continue groundwater remediation actions under post-closure care; includes certification and reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical corrections and definitional updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Several technical corrections to existing regulations, including definitions and cross-reference fixes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include definitions of 'technically feasible' and 'technically infeasible', wetlands reference correction, groundwater monitoring and corrective action applicability clarifications, publicly accessible internet site language, and document retention clarifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Severability of rule provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: EPA intent that provisions of the rule be severable such that invalidation of one provision will not necessarily invalidate the rest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EPA intends provisions governing each class of facilities and the substantive requirements within each set to operate independently; even if one requirement (e.g., closure) is set aside, others (e.g., GWMCA) should remain effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability criteria and statutory authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify which entities the rule applies to and the statutory authority for the rule under RCRA and related statutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule applies to CCR generated by entities within NAICS code 221112 (electric utilities and independent power producers) but is not exhaustive; directs readers to 40 CFR 257.50 for detailed applicability. EPA cites statutory authority: sections 1008(a), 2002(a), 3007, 4004, 4005(a) and (d) of RCRA and amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance deadlines and effective date
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the effective date of the final rule and various compliance deadlines (including EPA-provided deferrals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final rule effective November 4, 2024. Certain tasks have explicit deadlines (e.g., examples include initiating closure within 48 months for some units), and EPA has provided deferrals for some units/circumstances; deadlines vary by requirement and unit status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to Part B/Alternate Source Demonstration (ASD) process
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of the Part B alternative liner/alternate source demonstration process and EPA's handling of Part B submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes prior Part B Final Rule allowed limited demonstrations to show no reasonable probability of adverse effects; EPA reviewed Part B applications (including denials) and references to Part B determinations are included in the rule and docket materials.
